objective: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Dark Iron Scraps.

description: Have you ever seen Dreadnaught armor, <class>? No, of course you haven't. You're still a boy/girl - a tyke. Let me tell you, it is glorious.
You're probably asking yourself what any of this has to do with you, right? I'll tell you what, scrub; I need Dark Iron scraps and I'm willing to pay to get my hands on as many as possible.
I need the scraps to put together sets of Dreadnaught for our champions. Bring me scraps and get paid.
progress: What do you want? Directions? I can provide those...
completion: This will do, for now. If you get more, you know where to find me.
